note_fullstack: Full-stack Jac runs via `jac start main.jac --dev -p <ui> -a <api>`: the Vite dev server serves the cl UI on the UI port (app_base_url) and the API (def:pub/def:priv endpoints, /user auth) on a separate API port (api_base_url), with Vite proxying RPC. Backend-only contract runs can instead use `jac start main.jac -n` on a single port.

transport.note: Every domain operationId is a def:pub/def:priv function reached at POST /function/<operationId>. Path/query/body params are all sent in the JSON body keyed by parameter name (e.g. game_id, uci, opponent, fen, limit, offset).

auth.note: Auth is provided by the Jac runtime (jac start), not by an app endpoint. Register at /user/register, log in at /user/login to receive data.token (a JWT), then send 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on def:priv operations. Identity is {type:email,value:<email>}, credential is {type:password,password:<pw>}; emails must use a real domain (.local is rejected by the runtime).

response.app_error_convention: a function may return {"error": <msg>, "status": <N>} for a logical 4xx (e.g. an illegal move returns status 400); the harness maps that to the status
response.note: Jac wraps every function result in an envelope; the harness unwraps data.result and normalises the status. Reference functions return plain dicts (not raw nodes) so the wire shape matches the contract exactly.
